{"metadata":{"description":"办公三件套！Office document tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): generate, read, and edit spreadsheets (.xlsx), PDFs, and presentations (.pptx).","id":"gh:1334182694","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-office","slug":"omdsh-dev/dsh-office","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","office"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"办公三件套！Office document tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): generate, read, and edit spreadsheets (.xlsx"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"), PDFs, and presentations (.pptx)."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @huiliyi37/dsh-office"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Office document tools for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`): generate, read, and edit spreadsheets (`.xlsx`),"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" PDFs, presentations (`.pptx`), and Word documents (`.docx`)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Ported from the office plugins of the Tianshu terminal coding agent (Apache-2.0 licensed upstream), "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"adapted to the dsh cordis tool model."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Tool | What it does |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| `xlsx_read` | List sheets of a `.xlsx`, or read one sheet as a markdown table (range-limited for l"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"arge files; formula text preserved) |
| `xlsx_write` | Write a 2D array to a new `.xlsx` (formula ce"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"lls, header bold, column widths, number formats) |
| `xlsx_edit` | Edit an existing `.xlsx`: add she"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ets, update cells (value or formula), append rows |
| `xlsx_recalc` | Recalculate every formula with"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" a lightweight pure-TS engine and report error values (`#REF!`, `#DIV/0!`, `#VALUE!`, `#N/A`, `#NAME"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"?`, `#NUM!`) with locations |
| `xlsx_audit` | Statically audit formula structure: array-formula tra"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ps, aggregation ranges missing rows, formulas overwritten by hardcoded values, inconsistent formulas"},{"id":"p8s8","text":" in a column, self-references, division by zero |
| `pdf_create` | Generate a real PDF with headings"},{"id":"p8s9","text":", paragraphs, tables, lists, code blocks and footer page numbers; CJK text renders via an auto-detec"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"ted system font |
| `pdf_read` | Extract text from a PDF for reading into context |
| `pdf_merge` | "},{"id":"p8s11","text":"Merge multiple PDFs into one, in order |
| `pdf_split` | Split a PDF into single-page files, or extr"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"act pages by spec (`"1,3,5-7"`) |
| `pptx_create` | Generate a `.pptx` deck from slide definitions ("},{"id":"p8s13","text":"title / section / content / two-column / image / table / chart), with optional theme and speaker not"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"es |
| `pptx_read` | Extract slide text as markdown, optionally including speaker notes; `include` a"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"dds structure (summary/layouts/images/tables: shape names & cm positions, image targets, table dims)"},{"id":"p8s16","text":" |
| `pptx_edit` | Find/replace text inside an existing `.pptx` (`<a:t>` surgery), preserving all la"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"yout and styling |
| `docx_create` | Generate a real `.docx` Word document from content blocks (head"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"ing / paragraph / table / code / list), with optional striped tables, page background color, and dia"},{"id":"p8s19","text":"gonal text watermark |
| `docx_read` | Extract text from a `.docx` for reading into context |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install & load"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> **Compatibility**: `dsh` `0.1.0-rc.5`–`0.1.x` and the `0.2` line (including `0.2.0-rc.2`).
